item.description: While tools to organize critical family documents are useful, the true hurdle in estate planning is the emotional and logistical friction of actually sitting down to do the work, coupled with deep skepticism toward AI handling sensitive data and high subscription fees for simple data storage. The Illusion of Automated Reflection
item.description: Users find automated AI usage reports and memories generic, repetitive, or outright creepy. Instead, true value comes from immediate, active 'retrospectives' with the agent right after a session, or from specific, built-in skill commands rather than broad platform summaries. Quote: Thanks, I know that you know that, but I don't want you to show me that you know that.
